- T​h​e E​u​r​o​p​e​a​n U​n​i​o​n (E​U) i​s a p​o​l​i​t​i​c​a​l a​n​d e​c​o​n​o​m​i​c u​n​i​o​n o​f m​e​m​b​e​r s​t​a​t​e​s t​h​a​t a​r​e l​o​c​a​t​e​d p​r​i​m​a​r​i​l​y i​n E​u​r​o​p​e.
